title: A leaky bucket
summary: A neuron is a bucket that leaks. Fill it to the brim and it tips.

cards.text:
A neuron is a bucket.
Signal pours in like water.

The bucket has a hole.
Wait, and the water drains away.

lines: 4 is left. It does not tip.

question.prompt: The bucket tips when the water…
question.why: The brim is the line. Touch it, and it tips.
question.simpler: Water below the line just sits there, leaking. Only the brim makes a tip.

question.prompt: 4 is left and the brim is 10. Did it tip?
question.simpler: Compare the water with the brim. Smaller means it stays.

recall.question: A bucket tips when the water reaches what?

deeper.note: The bucket is the leaky integrate-and-fire neuron. Lapicque drew it as a capacitor and a leak in 1907. Abbott tells that story in two pages.

paper.title: Lapicque's introduction of the integrate-and-fire model neuron (1907)
paper.section: The whole note. It is the RC circuit and why a threshold-and-reset is enough.

bonus.prompt: Water is 9, brim is 10. You pour 4 and the hole takes 2. Does it tip?
bonus.simpler: Add the pour, then subtract the hole, then look at the brim.

terms.definition: How charged the neuron is. In the bucket picture, it is the water level.
Charge that drains over time, so an old input fades if nothing new arrives.
